name: mise-driver-native
description: Mise Driver — native iOS/Android wrapper around the Mise web driver app, with Geolocation, Camera, Push.

scripts.test:location: npx tsc native/location-contract.ts scripts/tests/native-location-contract.test.ts --module commonjs --target es2020 --outDir /tmp/mise-native-location-test --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck && node /tmp/mise-native-location-test/scripts/tests/native-location-contract.test.js && bash scripts/tests/native-location-source.sh
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
